title: Phase — Ingest spec
description: Read ticket/spec/AC; capture scope and constraints before a detailed PLAN.

steps.title: Read requirement sources
steps.notes: L0–L2: gather sources; write/update `.vibe/research/<task-id>.md` (canonical). If MCP fails or AC missing, document in Sources and use brainstorm/clarify — do not PLAN yet. See skill references.

steps.title: Lock scope & assumptions

execution_config.notes: List in-scope / out-of-scope; assumptions to confirm with PO/lead.

steps.notes: L3: concrete in/out scope on same `.vibe/research/<task-id>.md`. If spec not ready, BLOCKED in file — do not invent scope.
